title: 第8章 我是要成为海贼王的女人！
slug: 从素晴开始成为海贼王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

翌日清晨。

早已摸透林北作息的悠悠，一大早就拖着惠惠直奔冒险者公会。

然而今天和往常不太一样。

林北没有接任何任务，而是在角落的桌子上铺了一大张白布，正埋头画着什么。

二人好奇地眺望。

白布上是一个骷髅图案，只差寥寥几笔就能完工。

惠惠瞬间来了精神。

虽然不知道他为什么要画这种东西，但既然能画骷髅，想必一定是和自己拥有某些共同特征的人！

在得到悠悠的眼神许可后，她不再扭捏，径直走到林北面前，深吸一口气，摆开架势。

“吾名为……”

林北头也不抬的打断。

“我知道，惠惠，红魔族首屈一指的大魔法师，第一次见面的时候你就说过了。有什么事吗？”

惠惠当场就萎了，一时间不知道该怎么开口。

最后还是悠悠替她解释。

“那个……林北先生，请问可以让惠惠加入我们小队吗？”

我们小队？我什么时候跟她组队了？

不过林北更在意的是另一件事。

这两个人什么意思？看这架势，是想跟自己组队？

一提组队，他就感觉头疼。

原本以为招募告示贴出去，至少能招募到一两个伙伴。

结果这么多天过去，愣是没有一个人留言或上门询问。

为此他还专门找招待大姐姐打听过缘由，对方的回答相当直白：

“这儿的冒险者都懒散惯了，只愿意接那种事少钱多的活儿。出海对他们来说完全是陌生的领域，面对未知的风险和回报，除非真活不下去了，否则没人愿意尝试。”

这话让林北着实郁闷了好一阵。

可航海这种事，单靠一个人实在太难了。

他又不是鹰眼米霍克，随便找条长得像皮划艇似的东西就敢往海上漂。

不过……她们两个……

惠惠见他犹豫，连忙开口。

“林北先生，请您放心，我一定不会给您添麻烦的。而且我不需要平分报酬，您只要管我一天两顿饱饭，再给一些够日常开销的零花钱就好。”

Page (1/3)

The next morning.

Yuyou, who had already figured out Lin Bei's routine, dragged Megumi straight to the Adventurer's Guild early in the morning.

However, today is different from usual.

Lin Bei did not take any tasks, but spread a large white cloth on the table in the corner and was immersed in drawing something.

The two looked at it curiously.

On the white cloth is a skull pattern, which only requires a few strokes to complete.

Megumin instantly became energetic.

Although I don’t know why he would draw such a thing, since he can draw skeletons, he must be someone who shares some characteristics with himself!

After getting permission from Youyou's eyes, she stopped squirming and walked straight in front of Lin Bei, took a deep breath and put herself into position.

"My name is..."

Lin Bei interrupted without raising his head.

"I know, Megumin, the leading magician of the Crimson Demon Clan, you said it when we first met. What's the matter?"

Hui Hui shivered on the spot and didn't know what to say for a moment.

In the end, it was Youyou who explained for her.

"Um...Mr. Lin Bei, can Huihui join our team?"

Our team?When did I team up with her?

But Lin Bei was more concerned about another thing.

What do these two people mean?Looking at this posture, do you want to form a team with yourself?

He felt a headache when he mentioned forming a team.

I originally thought that by posting the recruitment notice, I would be able to recruit at least one or two partners.

As a result, after so many days, no one left a message or came to inquire.

For this reason, he specifically asked the host sister about the reason, and the other party's answer was quite straightforward:

"The adventurers here are used to being lazy and are only willing to take jobs that involve less work and more money. Going to sea is a completely unfamiliar territory for them. Faced with unknown risks and rewards, no one is willing to try it unless they really can't survive."

These words made Lin Bei really depressed for a while.

But sailing is too difficult for one person.

He is not Hawkeye Mihawk, who dares to find something that looks like a kayak and float it to the sea.

But...the two of them...

Seeing his hesitation, Hui Hui quickly spoke.

"Mr. Lin Bei, please rest assured that I will not cause you any trouble. And I don't need to share the reward equally. You just need to provide me with two full meals a day and give me some pocket money for daily expenses."
